description: This file contains the implementation of serialization and deserialization classes and helpers within the Orleans.Serialization namespace. It includes serializers for exceptions, collections, primitive types, and other data structures, as well as the core Serializer class and supporting buffer, reader, and writer components. Generated code annotations suggest it is part of a larger serialization framework for Orleans, enabling object serialization with custom codecs and copiers.
